items.title: Recruiter check

items.title: ATS-friendly

items.text: Resumes in several languages in one account; section titles follow the language.

items.title: Private by design
items.text: Your data is yours. Your resume is shared with employers only with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

items.title: Any device
items.text: Start on your phone, finish on your laptop. Nothing to install.

items.question: Is it really free? Will I be charged later?
items.answer: Yes, completely free. No feature is paid, PDF download included, and we never ask for your credit card. Donations cover our costs.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. The editor and PDF download work without one. An account is only for saving to the cloud, keeping versions and continuing on another device.

items.question: What is an ATS, and is my resume compatible?
items.answer: An ATS is software companies use to screen applications. Our templates output real text, not images, so these systems read your resume correctly.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: Without an account your resume stays in your browser only. With an account it is stored on our server, accessible only to you.

items.question: Should I add a photo?
items.answer: Common in Turkey and Germany, discouraged in the US and UK. You can turn the photo on or off in one tap on the Design tab.

cta.title: Your first resume is minutes away
